negative_control.bounded_support: News UK retained and commercialized a direct human research surface alongside its synthetic audience product.
negative_control.refused_generalization: The existence of Nucleus Panel does not establish that every Times ExplorAItion workflow uses matched human validation or that no bounded substitution occurs elsewhere.

required_next_evidence: named decision using both Times ExplorAItion and Nucleus Panel

prohibited_inferences: Do not infer that Nucleus Panel validates Times ExplorAItion merely because both sit inside News UK or Nucleus.
Do not infer that every synthetic workflow retains a matched human step.
Do not infer that the human panel has veto objective-control or remedy authority.
Do not infer that the parallel human product eliminates every bounded substitution risk.
Do not infer manipulation intent from the existence of synthetic or human commercial insight products.
Do not create a graph hop score chain actor profile allegation or thesis-evidence packet from this bounded negative control.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A bounded institutional negative control showing that News UK publicly operates direct human reader research alongside its synthetic audience product and describes the human surface as complementing AI-driven insight.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A matched validation study, proof that every synthetic workflow retains human research, a public-authorization finding, a causal-effect finding, or evidence of improper intent.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: News UK launched Nucleus Panel 85 days after Times ExplorAItion and explicitly positioned direct face-to-face reader research as a complement to AI-driven insight. This is counterevidence to an organization-wide all-human-research-replaced claim, but public materials do not establish a matched workflow, validation protocol, reconciliation rule, or binding affected-public authority.
